acts.title: Text A · A language you cannot hear the words of
text: La Gomera is a tiny Spanish island, and from the sea it looks like what it is: the tip of a volcano. Its hills are steep and its ravines are deep, which is why, for centuries, the islanders have not shouted across them. They have whistled.

Silbo Gomero is a real language, not a code. It consists of four vowels and four consonants, and the locals adapted it to Spanish when Spanish arrived. Two people standing three kilometres apart, on opposite sides of a ravine, can hold a conversation about anything at all.

To a visitor it is easy to confuse Silbo with birdsong. The first recording most people hear turns out, when it is translated, to be two men arranging a party and asking each other to bring a ukulele.

items.q: Why did the islanders develop a whistled language?
o: The ravines are too deep and steep to shout across

items.q: What does Text A say Silbo consists of?

acts.title: Text B · Why it nearly died out, and why it did not
text: By the 1980s Silbo was disappearing. Young people had left for the mainland, and those who stayed did not need it: the roads had improved, and the telephone had arrived. The development of mobile phones contributed to the decline more than anything else, although coverage on the island has never been good.
Some islanders disapproved of the whole idea of saving it. It was, they said, a peasant language that should be left to die out.

They lost the argument. In 1999 Silbo became a compulsory subject in the island’s primary schools, and in 2009 it was added to a UNESCO heritage list. The result is unusual: a language that almost vanished is now whistled by every child on the island, whether they want it or not.

acts.title: Verbs that take a fixed preposition
rule: Some verbs are followed by one preposition and no other. The preposition is not there for meaning — it is part of the verb, and it has to be learnt with it. Getting it wrong is the most visible B2 error in written work.
points: consist OF, disapprove OF, hear OF, contribute TO, adapt TO, result IN, insist ON, rely ON.
A noun, a pronoun, or an -ing form — never an infinitive. It resulted in losing the contract, not “resulted in to lose”.
result IN = the outcome. result FROM = the cause. The delay resulted in a fine; the fine resulted from the delay.
eg: Silbo consists of four vowels and four consonants.
consist of — never “consist from”.
Mobile phones contributed to the decline.
contribute to.
The locals adapted to the new roads quickly.
adapt to.
They disapproved of the whole idea.
disapprove of.
Have you heard of Silbo Gomero?
hear of = know it exists. hear about = know the details.
Getting it wrong can result in a misunderstanding.
result in + noun.
It resulted in losing the contract.
result in + -ing, never an infinitive.
The fine resulted from the delay.
result from = the other direction.
She insisted on paying for everybody.
insist on + -ing.
You can rely on him to turn up.
rely on somebody to do something.
acts.careful: These verbs keep their preposition even when the object moves to the front: “the decline that mobile phones contributed to”. Do not drop it.

write.q: Write about a language, a craft or a tradition in your own country that is disappearing, or that nearly disappeared and was saved. Use at least four verbs from this lesson with their correct prepositions, and put those verbs in CAPITALS so you can check them afterwards.
plan: what it is and what it consists of
write.model:
In the villages north of Karaganda there is a way of felting wool that CONSISTS OF eleven stages, none of which is written down anywhere. Until about 1970 every household could do it.

Two things CONTRIBUTED TO its disappearance. The first was cheap factory blankets. The second, less obviously, was the road: once people could reach the city in an hour, the older women who knew the process no longer had anybody at home to teach.

A few families ADAPTED TO the change by selling to tourists, which most of the neighbours DISAPPROVED OF at the time. They were probably right that it cheapened it. They were also wrong about the outcome, because it RESULTED IN the eleven stages surviving. Nothing else did.
